code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if v := grid[r][c]]
    candidates = []
    for coord in (0, 1):  # sum, difference
        vals = [r + c if coord == 0 else c - r for r, c, _ in points]
        for period in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
            colors = {}
            ok = True
            for (_, _, color), value in zip(points, vals):
                key = value % period
                if key in colors and colors[key] != color:
                    ok = False
                    break
                colors[key] = color
            if ok:
                candidates.append((period, coord, colors))
                break
    period, coord, colors = min(candidates, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    return [[colors[(r + c if coord == 0 else c - r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
